text:
maria_ops: getting an alert — /v1/generate 5xx spike across hosted-api (edgeset us-west) starting ~08:03 UTC, error rate up to ~12% :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: deploy 1769999988 completed to canary (2%). Flags: shadow_prefetch_kv=true, route_tagging=off, batch_window=0.

jamie_eng: logs show a bunch of upstream 504s from inference-runtime during KV cache cold path. stack traces look like timeouts waiting on rpc to kvcache-service. sample: ```rpc timeout to kvcache-1: context deadline exceeded```

kevin_sre: confirmed customer-facing timeouts and downstream billing job failures. Paging customers with support incident queue. Putting rollback on deck.

maria_ops: @kevin_sre can you verify if the canary received tags meant for shadow (traffic-shift 0.02) vs shadow-only? I think the route_tagging flag flip might have misrouted some traffic into the canary runtime.

jamie_eng: checking canary config now — our rollout tooling shows the flag matrix for the canary cluster includes shadow_prefetch_kv=true AND route_tagging=false which was supposed to be only for shadow testbed. Looks like a mapping bug in the release manifest.

kevin_sre: rolling back canary to previous commit (1769999900) now. Command: ```rollout abort --env=hosted --target=canary --commit=1769999900``` ETA ~2m.

deploy-bot: rollback started by kevin_sre (run id r-2026-03-17-08-07). Notifying autoscaler and routing plane.

maria_ops: repro steps for support notes — 1) call /v1/generate with long context (>1024) 2) use model variant 'redwood-large' 3) observe 502/504 within 1-3s. Customers saw increased token billing retries because client retried sync until timeout.

sophie_product: any impact on SLA or billing reconciliation? We have a few customers reporting failed invoice generation because the billing webhook retries hit 502s. We need a postmortem note for affected accounts.

jamie_eng: confirmed kvcache service experienced connection pile-up from canary workers after new prefetch logic changed prefetch concurrency. It touched the kernel-sched path and increased tail latency. We'll add a safety cap to prefetch concurrency and add healthcheck gating. Patch PR: #4921.

kevin_sre: rollback finished. Error rate dropping in last 30s. Can confirm routed traffic back to stable. Monitoring for 10m then close. :thumbsup:

maria_ops: filing a support escalation summary for customers impacted and a timeline. Add RC: human error in manifest mapping + missing gating in release tooling.

sophie_product: linking this to account ops and billing to reconcile failed invoice runs. Also add customer comms draft.

jamie_eng: follow-ups: 1) revert the manifest mapping check to be stricter, 2) add canary healthcheck for kvcache RPC latency, 3) add automated test to prevent route_tagging=false from rolling to canary, 4) add metric alert for kvcache tail p99.

maria_ops: thanks all. tagging postmortem owners @jamie_eng + @kevin_sre. closing thread once billing reconciliation complete.

pagerbot: Incident resolved (r-2026-03-17-08-12) — severity reduced to P2.
